Subject: Cadet.ai — technical immersion scheduling & attendee alignment

Hi Samantha — great conversation earlier today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock a technical immersion with our ML/infra engineers:

- Goal: 60–90 minute technical immersion to walk your infra & ML teams through integration options, performance profile, and security posture.
- Suggested agenda (draft): 1) context + current infra; 2) model/service architecture & request patterns; 3) latency/cost targets + batching strategy; 4) security/compliance + data flows; 5) rollouts & runbook.
- Ask: Can you confirm the right Cadet attendees (infra lead + ML engineer + security lead if required)?
- Two calendar options we have open (PT):
  * Tue 24 Jun — 90 min window: 10:00–11:30 PT
  * Thu 26 Jun — 60 min window: 13:00–14:00 PT

If neither fits, send 2x preferred windows and well match. Im looping Ben (solutions) to coordinate attendee/ops readiness and Grace (customer success) for onboarding items.

Pre-reads: I attached a short one-pager outlining the typical data-flow patterns we discuss. Well send a calendar invite once we lock a slot.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198

Thanks Samantha — locking Thu 26 Jun 13:00–14:00 PT for a 60-minute technical immersion. Confirmed attendees (internal): Jordan Blake, Ben Carter (solutions), Grace O'Connor (CS). External: Samantha, Luke, Tien (+ possible InfoSec: Sara).

Updated agenda (60m):
0–5m: Introductions & success criteria
5–20m: Cadet current infra + traffic profile (Luke/Tien)
20–40m: Redwood runtime & integration options (Ben) — batching, KV/prefix cache, quantization tradeoffs
40–50m: Security & data-flow clarifications (Jordan/Grace)
50–60m: Next steps & mutual action items (all)

Pre-reads attached: redwood-tdx-preread.md (short checklist) and I pulled together a one-page on caching behavior that addresses the KV cache questions. We will include those as links in the invite.

Action items for Cadet before the call:
- Share any traffic stats (qps, tail latency targets) and sample request shape if possible
- Confirm whether InfoSec (Sara) will join — if yes, share any required compliance artifacts in advance

Ill send a calendar invite with the agenda and links; Ben will own the demo/runbook section. Grace will follow up post-call on onboarding + trial plan.
